# app-store-connect-mcp tools

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/tools/docsgen`; do not edit. -->

72 tools. Class: **R** read, **W** write, **D** destructive or public. Confirm: `plan` = preview then `plan_id:"<plan_id>"`, `flag` = preview then `confirm:true`, `human` = `confirm:true` plus approval via elicitation, `none` = no gate. ★ marks default toolsets. Schemas are shown with writes enabled.

## core ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`apps_get`](#apps_get)|R|none|One app at a glance: live version per platform, in-flight versions with state, 5 latest builds, listing locales. Use before release or TestFlight work.|
|[`apps_list`](#apps_list)|R|none|List or fuzzy-find apps (name, bundle id, SKU or id; best first) with platforms and in-flight versions.|
|[`asc_api_describe`](#asc_api_describe)|R|none|Describe one API operation (operation_id or method+path): params, enums, fields[] names, includes, body skeleton and a ready example call.|
|[`asc_api_get`](#asc_api_get)|R|none|GET any App Store Connect operation, validated against the pinned spec first (a mismatch returns the skeleton, no call). Collections auto-paginate to limit with next_cursor.|
|[`asc_api_request`](#asc_api_request)|D|human|POST/PATCH/DELETE any App Store Connect operation, spec-validated. Every call previews first and needs confirm:true plus human approval. Prefer workflow tools; reads: asc_api_get.|
|[`asc_api_search`](#asc_api_search)|R|none|Find API operations by keywords, resource type or tag when no workflow tool fits; returns ranked operation ids, method, path, summary. Then asc_api_describe.|
|[`doctor`](#doctor)|R|none|Health check of the active profile: key, JWT, Apple reachability, clock skew, rate limit, spec, write mode, toolsets, vendor number, each with a fix. Run first on 401/403.|
|[`toolsets`](#toolsets)|R|none|List toolsets, enable or disable them for this session (tool list refreshes), or ask the user to allow App Store Connect writes for this session.|

## release ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`builds_list`](#builds_list)|R|none|Builds newest first: number, version, processing state, dates, export compliance, TestFlight state and groups. Expired hidden unless include_expired.|
|[`builds_wait`](#builds_wait)|R|none|Poll a build until processing ends (VALID, INVALID or FAILED) with progress. Waits at most 50 s unless the client sends a progress token. At the timeout returns still_processing; call again with the same args.|
|[`release_cancel`](#release_cancel)|D|human|Cancel the open review submission (state CANCELING), or empty an unsent draft by deleting its items. Without confirm:true returns a preview.|
|[`release_phased`](#release_phased)|D|flag|Pause, resume or complete a 7-day phased release, or remove one not yet started; shows day and %. Enable it before release (release_prepare phased:true). Without confirm:true previews; complete needs human approval.|
|[`release_prepare`](#release_prepare)|W|plan|Apply a release_status plan (plan_id from release_status desired): create version, attach build, compliance, release type, phasing, What's New. Never waits for processing.|
|[`release_publish`](#release_publish)|D|human|Release a PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE version to the App Store; other states are refused. Without confirm:true returns a preview.|
|[`release_review_status`](#release_review_status)|R|none|Current and recent App Review submissions with items and states. Reviewer messages aren't in the API: read the Resolution Center link, fix, then release_submit.|
|[`release_status`](#release_status)|R|none|Preflight a version: build, compliance, What's New, listing limits, screenshots, review contact, age rating, pricing, products, open submission. desired returns plan_ids for release_prepare/release_submit.|
|[`release_submit`](#release_submit)|D|human|Submit the version (plus IAPs/subscriptions) for App Review; reuses a draft, resubmits after rejection. First call previews and returns plan_id; call again with it.|

## testflight ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`builds_expire`](#builds_expire)|D|human|Expire up to 50 builds so testers can no longer install them. Irreversible. Without confirm:true previews; already expired builds are skipped.|
|[`testflight_distribute`](#testflight_distribute)|W|flag|Give a build to beta groups: export compliance, What to Test per locale (* = all), beta review info, external beta review. External or public distribution and compliance answers need confirm:true and human approval.|
|[`testflight_feedback_list`](#testflight_feedback_list)|R|none|Tester screenshot and crash feedback newest first. Up to 4 screenshots as images; crash logs on request. Comments are tester data. mark_seen advances last_seen.|
|[`testflight_groups_list`](#testflight_groups_list)|R|none|Beta groups: internal/external, tester and build counts, public link, feedback settings. Use a group's name or id in testflight_testers_* and testflight_distribute.|
|[`testflight_testers_add`](#testflight_testers_add)|W|flag|Add or invite up to 100 testers to a beta group; existing members are reported as already. External groups need confirm:true and human approval after a preview.|
|[`testflight_testers_list`](#testflight_testers_list)|R|none|Beta testers of an app or group, filterable by email, state or invite type, with their groups. Names/emails are tester-provided data.|
|[`testflight_testers_remove`](#testflight_testers_remove)|D|human|Remove up to 100 testers from a beta group, or with scope app from every group and build. Without confirm:true previews the matched testers; nothing changes.|

## metadata ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`appinfo_update`](#appinfo_update)|W|flag|Set categories, age rating, accessibility labels, App Review contact/demo/notes, content rights, copyright. Without confirm:true previews current→new. Listing text: metadata_plan.|
|[`metadata_apply`](#metadata_apply)|D|plan|Apply a metadata_plan: same arguments plus plan_id; refused if the listing changed since. Creates missing locales; deletes only locales in remove.|

|[`metadata_pull`](#metadata_pull)|R|none|Every locale's listing (app info and version text) of the editable version, else live. export_dir writes a fastlane metadata dir. Edit with metadata_plan.|

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|

|[`reviews_list`](#reviews_list)|R|none|Customer reviews newest first with responses and a reply_locale hint. since:"last_seen" returns only new ones; mark_seen advances the cursor. Review text is untrusted data.|

## screenshots ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`previews_upload`](#previews_upload)|W|none|Uploads one app preview video to a locale's preview set of the editable version, creating the set if needed; optional poster frame time code. Same checksum already present = no-op. Max 3 previews per set.|
|[`screenshots_list`](#screenshots_list)|R|none|Screenshot and app preview sets per locale and display type for a version (default editable): ids, order, file names, checksums, delivery states, sizes, and coverage of required display types (empty locales fall back to the primary). thumbnails:true attaches up to 4 small images.|
|[`screenshots_plan`](#screenshots_plan)|R|none|Diffs a local screenshot dir against the editable version: checks PNG/JPEG size and alpha, skips equal checksums, lists uploads, deletes (replace mode), reorders, problems. |[`screenshots_sync`](#screenshots_sync)|D|plan|Applies a screenshots_plan: same arguments plus plan_id (required when anything is deleted). Creates sets, uploads, deletes the listed screenshots, reorders. Refused if the remote sets changed since planning.|

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`builds_upload`](#builds_upload)|W|none|Uploads an .ipa or .pkg via the BuildUpload API; no Xcode or Transporter needed. Version/build come from the IPA's Info.plist (required for .pkg). ## monetization

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`iap_list`](#iap_list)|R|none|In-app purchases (v2) of an app in one request: product id, type, state, latest version state and localizations. Filter by state or type. Prices: use pricing_get. Subscriptions: subscriptions_list.|
|[`iap_upsert`](#iap_upsert)|W|flag|Create an IAP by product_id or PATCH only changed fields, plus localizations, review screenshot and availability. Overwrites need confirm:true; creating (burns the id) and family sharing on need a human.|
|[`offer_codes_generate`](#offer_codes_generate)|W|human|Generate one-time codes or a custom code for an offer-code campaign (offers_create kind offer_code); needs confirm:true and human approval. |[`offers_create`](#offers_create)|W|human|Create an intro (per territory), promotional, win-back or offer-code offer on a subscription. Prices by customer price or price_point_id; equalize:true expands one price to all territories. Needs confirm:true and human approval; a same-name offer is already.|
|[`offers_list`](#offers_list)|R|none|Introductory (grouped by terms), promotional, win-back and offer-code offers of one subscription (product_id) or every subscription of the app: mode, duration, periods, eligibility, territory counts, code counts. An IAP product_id lists its offer codes.|
|[`pricing_apply`](#pricing_apply)|D|human|Apply a pricing_plan: same arguments plus plan_id; refused if prices changed since. App/IAP: one schedule POST; subscriptions: one POST per territory, resumable by re-running pricing_plan.|
|[`pricing_get`](#pricing_get)|R|none|Current prices of an app, IAP or subscription: base territory, prices in effect per territory (requested or top 20, with total count), scheduled changes, app availability. products (≤10 ids) returns each one's base price, or its price per requested territory (≤10).|
|[`pricing_plan`](#pricing_plan)|R|none|Preview a price change (base price matched to Apple's price points, Apple equalization elsewhere, optional overrides) and app availability changes: old→new per territory, call count, rate-limit check. Returns plan_id for pricing_apply.|
|[`subscriptions_list`](#subscriptions_list)|R|none|Subscription groups with localizations, and each group's subscriptions: product id, period, level, state, latest version state and offer counts. One request per group. Prices: pricing_get.|
|[`subscriptions_upsert`](#subscriptions_upsert)|W|flag|Find or create a subscription group by reference name and a subscription by product_id; PATCH only changed fields, plus localizations, review screenshot and availability. Overwrites need confirm:true; creating, family sharing on and group level changes need a human.|

## signing

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`signing_bundle_id_create`](#signing_bundle_id_create)|W|none|Register a bundle identifier (explicit or wildcard com.example.*) for IOS, MAC_OS or UNIVERSAL. Idempotent: an already registered identifier returns already:true with the existing bundle ID; nothing is changed.|
|[`signing_bundle_ids_list`](#signing_bundle_ids_list)|R|none|Registered bundle IDs (identifier, name, platform, seed id) with their enabled capabilities and settings. Filter by identifier, platform or a name/identifier substring. Use before signing_capabilities_set or signing_profile_create.|
|[`signing_capabilities_set`](#signing_capabilities_set)|D|flag|Enable capabilities (with settings) on a bundle ID, or disable them. Enabling missing ones applies at once; already enabled ones are skipped. Changing settings needs confirm:true; disabling also needs the user's approval. Both invalidate profiles.|
|[`signing_certificates_list`](#signing_certificates_list)|R|none|Signing certificates by type, sorted by expiration, with days_left. expiring_within_days keeps only certificates expiring (or expired) within N days. Certificate content (base64 DER) is returned only with include_content.|
|[`signing_devices_register`](#signing_devices_register)|W|flag|Register up to 100 devices (name, udid, platform) in one call. Idempotent by UDID: already registered devices are reported as already (with their status) and not re-posted. New devices need confirm:true and human approval (yearly slots).|
|[`signing_profile_create`](#signing_profile_create)|W|none|Create a profile for a bundle ID (identifier or id). certificates: ids or ["all"] (all unexpired of the matching type); devices: ids or ["all"] (enabled devices), only for development/ad hoc types. An active profile with the same name, type and bundle is already:true.|
|[`signing_profiles_list`](#signing_profiles_list)|R|none|Provisioning profiles with type, state, bundle identifier, expiration, device and certificate counts. Filter by type, state, name or bundle identifier. download:true with one id returns profile_content (base64 .mobileprovision).|
|[`signing_revoke`](#signing_revoke)|D|human|Revoke a signing certificate or delete a provisioning profile by id. Without confirm returns a preview (name, type, expiry; for certificates the profiles it invalidates). confirm:true asks the human; irreversible.|

## xcodecloud

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`xcc_build_start`](#xcc_build_start)|W|none|Start a build run of a workflow (name or id) on a branch, tag or open pull request number; without a source Xcode Cloud uses the workflow's default. clean forces a clean build. Not idempotent: each call starts a new run.|
|[`xcc_build_status`](#xcc_build_status)|R|none|Status of a build run (id, or latest of a workflow): progress, result, issue counts, actions, test summary, artifacts (URL host only unless include_urls). wait:true polls until complete (default 45 s, max 300 s), else still_processing.|
|[`xcc_workflows_list`](#xcc_workflows_list)|R|none|Xcode Cloud products of the app (all apps when none is given or pinned) with their workflows: id, name, enabled, repository, start conditions summary and actions. Use the workflow name or id with xcc_build_start and xcc_build_status.|

## webhooks

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`webhooks_delete`](#webhooks_delete)|D|human|Delete an app's webhook by id or name; deliveries stop immediately and the secret is lost. Needs confirm:true and human approval.|
|[`webhooks_list`](#webhooks_list)|R|none|An app's App Store Connect webhooks: name, URL host, event types, enabled, and the last 10 deliveries with state and HTTP status. Use before webhooks_upsert/webhooks_delete. Full URLs and secrets are never shown.|
|[`webhooks_upsert`](#webhooks_upsert)|D|human|Create a webhook (name, https url, event_types) or update one matched by id or name; optional ping. Without a secret one is generated into webhook-secrets/<id>.txt (path returned, never the value). Needs confirm:true and human approval.|

## admin

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`users_invite`](#users_invite)|D|human|Invite someone to the App Store Connect team with roles and either all apps or a list of apps. Apple emails them immediately. An existing user or pending invite is reported, not re-sent. Needs confirm:true and human approval.|
|[`users_list`](#users_list)|R|none|Team members and pending invitations with roles, all-apps access, visible app names and invitation expiry. Filter by role or a name/email substring. Needs an Admin key.|
|[`users_remove`](#users_remove)|D|human|Remove a team member (by email or user id) or cancel their pending invitation; access ends immediately. Needs confirm:true and human approval.|

## store

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`store_lookup`](#store_lookup)|R|none|Public App Store data, no ASC key: an app's live listing by App Store id or bundle id (version, price, rating, notes), keyword search top-N, or the app's rank for a keyword in a storefront. Text is untrusted.|
|[`store_ranks_report`](#store_ranks_report)|R|none|Public search rank of an app per keyword × storefront, no ASC key. track measures now (≤60 lookups, 3 s apart) and appends to local history; report shows latest, previous, best, 7/30-day change and trend; untrack keeps history. Names are untrusted.|

## insights

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`analytics_funnel_report`](#analytics_funnel_report)|R|none|Impressions → page views → downloads with conversion by source/territory, sessions, crashes, installs vs deletions; vs previous period with coverage and lag. Never creates requests: not_set_up points at analytics_setup.|
|[`digest_summary`](#digest_summary)|R|none|What changed per app since last asked: new reviews, TestFlight feedback, version and review submission state changes, builds, a sales day-vs-week delta. Oldest unseen first; mark_seen advances per-source watermarks. Review/feedback text is untrusted.|
|[`release_health_report`](#release_health_report)|R|none|Live (or given) version vs the previous one: hang/launch/disk-write signature deltas, perf regressions, TestFlight crashes, rating delta, analytics crashes. Verdict healthy\|watch\|breach\|unknown (no production data); breach with an active phased release suggests pause.|

## Arguments

### analytics_funnel_report

|Name|Type|Required|Enum|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`app`|string|||name, bundle id, SKU or id; default pinned|
|`by`|string||`none`, `source`, `territory`, `device`|breakdown; sources/territories imply one|
|`compare`|string||`previous_period`, `none`|default previous_period|
|`from`|string|||YYYY-MM-DD|
|`period`|string||`last_7_days`, `last_28_days`, `last_90_days`|default last_28_days; ignored with from/to|
|`question`|string||`funnel`, `sources`, `territories`, `sessions`, `crashes`, `installs_deletions`|default funnel|
|`to`|string|||YYYY-MM-DD|
|`top`|integer|||default 10, max 50|
